name: io.github.hpdkhoa/modellab-mcp
title: Model Lab
description: Draws rigged game gun models in Blender from parameters, checked against the real gun

environmentVariables.name: MODELLAB_BLENDER
environmentVariables.description: Blender's executable (4.2 or later), if it is not on the PATH or in the usual install folder

environmentVariables.name: MODELLAB_OUT
environmentVariables.description: The only folder Model Lab writes to (builds, clips, comparisons); defaults to ~/.modellab

environmentVariables.name: MODELLAB_WAIT_FOR
environmentVariables.description: Optional process names that hold the machine (e.g. UnrealEditor.exe,blender.exe); a build refuses to start while one runs
